title: Puck counters report (puck.counters.report.v1)
description: A puck.counters.report.v1 document: what puck counters read from one authored workload booted offscreen once per backend, every count tagged with the WorkClass its owner declared. Two reports of the same workload at the same code agree on every deterministic count; puck counters compare says where they do not.

revision.description: The source the World that produced the counts was built from.

sourceState.description: The key of the World build that ran: a hash of the World's source closure including every uncommitted change, so two reports with equal keys ran the same code.

revision.title: WorldCountersRevision

workload.description: The workload's world document, repository-relative with forward slashes.

script.description: The workload's console script, repository-relative with forward slashes.

runs.description: One run per backend, in the order they ran.

items.description: One backend's run of the workload.

backend.description: The backend the World was booted on: vulkan or directx.

device.description: The device the render nodes ran on, as the backend reported it at creation.
device.title: GpuDeviceIdentity

width.description: The offscreen presentation's width in pixels.

height.description: The offscreen presentation's height in pixels.

compiler.description: The shader toolchain's identity: the hash the shader cache keys on, over each tool's path, timestamp and version.

gcMode.description: The World process's GC mode, which an allocation reading is taken under.

counts.description: Every count the run read, in the order the World reported them.

items.description: One count a run read, named by where it was read and tagged with its class.

source.description: The section the count was read from: a counter source's name, gpu, or allocation.

node.description: The render node, for a count of the gpu section; otherwise null.

pass.description: The pass, for a GPU count recorded inside one; otherwise null.

kind.description: The kind's dotted name, or for an allocation reading the window's name.

class.description: What two readings of the count may be expected to agree on.
class.title: WorkClass

value.description: The count; for an allocation reading, the fewest bytes a run of the window allocated.

items.title: WorldCount

passes.description: Every render node's passes in its newest completed submission, in pass order.

items.description: What one pass of a render node did in its newest completed submission. A pass's state is deterministic: the same inputs execute, skip, or leave unreached the same passes on every backend.
items.title: WorldCountersPass
WorldCountersRun

schema.description: Gets the document schema tag — SchemaVersion for a well-formed document.
